verdict.rationale: Greenhouse's own marketing describes several in-product AI features that produce insights from customer data. Offer Forecast uses machine learning to flag whether roles are on track. Talent Matching sorts applications into tiers by risk and relevance. Notetaker generates AI summaries mapped to scorecard questions, and the platform lists AI-powered report filters. All of this comes from short vendor marketing claims, with no in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration, and nothing shows a general insights or suggestions layer across your data. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how the AI insights and suggestions surface and work, a general-purpose AI insights or recommendations capability across reporting data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Greenhouse Offer Forecast – Leverage machine learning to ensure roles are on track based on target offer acceptances and start dates

Talent Matching is a core component of Real Talent™, a new Greenhouse feature set designed to help customers tackle overwhelming candidate pipelines by analyzing and filtering applications into tiers based on risk and relevance.
Greenhouse Notetaker automatically records and transcribes interviews, then instantly maps AI-generated notes directly to scorecard questions
